text:
Sam (Silverline): Hey team — we got invoice INV-2024-0789 (issued 2024-07-11) and the total looks off. Charge jumped to $12,374 vs our expected ~$1,200. Seems a lot of calls were attributed to project 'silverline-dev' instead of 'silverline-prod'. Can you review? We need a manual credit if this is on your side.

Matt (Finance): Hi Sam — can you paste the invoice number + date and a sample of the usage lines/export? We'll triage.

Sam (Silverline): Invoice INV-2024-0789, 2024-07-11. Sample from our export: 
```
date,project,model,usage_tokens,cost
2024-07-09,silverline-dev/gpt-3.5,redwood-embed,240000,10200.00
2024-07-09,silverline-prod/gpt-3.5,redwood-embed,24000,1020.00
```
We think a batch import env var mislabelled project tags during a large run.

Tanvi (AM): cc @Matt (Finance) — recommend fast-tracking a goodwill/technical credit while eng verifies. If confirmed finance can issue a credit for the delta and prorate next invoice.

Matt (Finance): Sounds good. @Eli (Eng) can you check whether tags were flipped on the ingestion job around 2024-07-09 and estimate misattributed tokens?

Eli (Eng): Looking now. Quick query against usage logs: 
```
SELECT project_tag, SUM(tokens) FROM usage_records WHERE date='2024-07-09' GROUP BY project_tag;
-> silverline-dev: 2,400,000 tokens
-> silverline-prod: 240,000 tokens
```
Matches the 10x ratio in the CSV. I see a deploy on 2024-07-09 that set ENV PROJECT=silverline-dev on the batch worker. Root cause confirmed. Estimated misattributed tokens ~2,160,000 => approx $9,180.

Matt (Finance): Thanks Eli. We'll prepare a credit for the delta (invoice rounding/discounts TBD). @BillingBot can you create a manual credit memo for INV-2024-0789 for ~$9,154 and route to finance-approvals?

BillingBot: Created ticket BILL-2024-331 for manual credit memo. Assigned to Matt (Finance).

Matt (Finance): Filing internal memo: reason 'misattributed usage due to ingestion env var swap'. Will allocate cost back to product and include in next month reconciliation. Tanvi, can you confirm customer is OK with the credit + apology note?

Tanvi (AM): I'll send the note now and ask if they'd like a short postmortem. Sam, I'll DM a draft for approval.

Sam (Silverline): Thanks everyone, really appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray: We'll review the DM and confirm.

Matt (Finance): Once Sam signs off I'll push the credit and update the invoice records. :thumbsup:
